snippet.title: Oops Unit -  Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Oops Unit is an online co-op where up to 6 players team up as a bomb squad
➤ Play the Demo on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4574260/Oops_Unit_Demo

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Oops Unit is an online co-op game where up to 6 players team up as a bomb squad. Solve puzzles, gather resources, and push through deadly traps to reach and defuse every bomb. Extract safely, buy new gear, and repeat—or die trying, because anything, even your friends, can sabotage the mission.
